grades.reason: Only says RVWMO does not formally describe SFENCE.VMA and points elsewhere. It says nothing about ASID, satp, or how SFENCE.VMA selects translations.

grades.quote: The SINVAL.VMA instruction invalidates any address-translation cache entries that an SFENCE.VMA instruction with the same values of _rs1_ and _rs2_ would invalidate.
grades.reason: This is the Svinval extension. It labels SINVAL.VMA's rs2 as asid and rs1 as vaddr. It says SINVAL.VMA invalidates the same entries as an SFENCE.VMA with the same rs1 and rs2, which implies SFENCE.VMA's rs2 is an ASID selector. It never explains the satp ASID field or how SFENCE.VMA applies the ASID, so it is only indirect, auxiliary help.
This describes the LoongArch ASID CSR and the LoongArch TLB instructions INVTLB and TLBSRCH. The query requires RISC-V satp and SFENCE.VMA, so this is the wrong ISA.
